paragraphs.text: Read-only semantic code navigation for DeepSeek Harness via local language servers: definitions, ref
erences, symbols, diagnostics, hover, and rename preview.
# Code Intel for DSH
> Serena showed that coding agents need **symbol-precise** navigation, not just grep. This is a smal

l,
> read-only DSH port of that workflow: local LSP servers, four tools, no embeddings, no hosted in

port of that workflow: local LSP servers, four tools, no embeddings, no hosted index,
> no API key.
## What it adds
| Tool | Job |

| `code_definition` | Jump to the real definition |
| `code_references` | Find impact before editing

|
| `code_symbols` | Search classes/functions/variables |
| `code_diagnostics` | Compiler/type diag

nostics for one file |
| `code_hover` | Type/documentation at a symbol |
| `code_rename` | Preview r
ename edits **without writing** |
All six are **read-only**. `code_rename` returns a preview; it never writes files. Apply the preview
with your normal editing tool after review.

| TypeScript / JavaScript | `npm i -g typescript-language-server typescript@5.9` |
| Python | `pip i

nstall pyright` |
| Go | `go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest` |
| Rust | `rustup component a

dd rust-analyzer` |
| C / C++ | install LLVM `clangd` |

## Design

- One short-lived language-server process per call; no background daemon to leak.
- JSON-RPC over st

dio, no dependencies.
- Server selection by file extension, or explicit `language`.
- Timeouts and i

nstall hints instead of silent fallback.
- Path containment check before opening a file.
- Diagnosti
cs use `publishDiagnostics`; a server that only supports pull diagnostics returns none.
## Real-server smoke

With `typescript@5.9.3` and `typescript-language-server@5.3.0`, definition and references were
smoke

-tested against a small `.ts` file (1 definition, 2 references). The Python path was also
smoke-test

ed with `pyright-langserver` (1 definition, 2 references). `code_symbols` needs a project
context; f

or TypeScript, add a `tsconfig.json` and/or pass `file` so the server opens a project
file first, or

it may answer `No Project`. The bundled
fake server keeps `npm test` independent of installed langu

er `No Project`. The bundled
fake server keeps `npm test` independent of installed language servers.
## What it does not do

- No write, apply-edit, or rename application. `code_rename` is preview-only.
- No cross-repo index,

embeddings, or remote service.
- No guarantee that diagnostics equal a clean test run.
- No claim o
f parity with Serena's full feature set.
## Provenance

Inspired by Serena; no source code copied. See `NOTICE.md`.
License: MIT.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

ed
with `typescript@5.9.3` and `typescript-language-server@5.3.0` (definition 1, references 2).
